# Boot splash (`boot-splash`)

An animated start screen with the product mark.

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createBootSplash` (types in `dist/web/foundations/bootSplash.d.ts`): `.mh-boot-splash`: the start screen shown while an app or device boots. The canvas backdrop, the mark (its tiles fly in, then glint one after another), the name, a status message and an optional progress bar. Parts `__content`, `__mark`, `__tile`, `__name`, `__message`, `__progress`; `.is-leaving` while it fades out.

```ts
export function createBootSplash(options: BootSplashOptions = {}): BootSplashHandle;

export interface BootSplashOptions {
  /** The product name under the mark. */
  name?: string;
  /** What is happening, e.g. "Connecting…"; announced politely when it changes. */
  message?: string;
  /** `undefined`: no bar. `null`: an indeterminate bar. A number: percent done. */
  progress?: number | null;
  /** Accessible name of the progress bar; default "Starting". */
  progressLabel?: string;
  /** Replaces the four-tile mark. */
  mark?: Node;
  /** Fill the parent (position: absolute) rather than the viewport. */
  inline?: boolean;
  /** Runs once `dismiss()` has removed the splash. */
  onDismissed?: () => void;
}

export interface BootSplashHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setMessage(message: string): void;
  setProgress(progress: number | null | undefined): void;
  /** Fades the splash out and removes it; resolves when it is gone. */
  dismiss(): Promise<void>;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createBootSplash } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const splash = createBootSplash({ name: 'Mosaic Home', message: 'Starting…', progress: null });
document.body.append(splash.el);

const steps = ['Connecting…', 'Loading rooms…', 'Almost ready…'];
const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

async function boot(): Promise<void> {
  for (const [i, step] of steps.entries()) {
    await wait(900);
    splash.setMessage(step);
    splash.setProgress(((i + 1) / steps.length) * 100);
  }
  await splash.dismiss();
  document.body.append('Welcome home');
}

void boot();
```

export function BootSplash({ name, message, progress, progressLabel = 'Starting', mark, inline, leaving = false, onLeft, className }: BootSplashProps);

export interface BootSplashProps {

  mark?: ReactNode;
  inline?: boolean;
  /** Fade out; `onLeft` runs when the fade has finished, and the parent then unmounts the splash. */

  onLeft?: () => void;

}

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { BootSplash } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const steps = ['Starting…', 'Connecting…', 'Loading rooms…', 'Almost ready…'];

export function BootSplashExample() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [booted, setBooted] = useState(false);
  const ready = step >= steps.length - 1;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ready) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setStep((s) => s + 1), 900);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [step, ready]);

  if (booted) return <p>Welcome home</p>;
  return (
    <BootSplash
      name="Mosaic Home"
      message={steps[step]}
      progress={step === 0 ? null : (step / (steps.length - 1)) * 100}
      leaving={ready}
      onLeft={() => setBooted(true)}
    />
  );
}
```
